open_points.subject: A30: Accepted decision A30 — Configuration — meaning of an empty REGISTRY_BASE_URL
open_points.text: a missing or empty value stops the start
open_points.question: Is emptiness tested on the raw environment string or after normalization such as trimming whitespace?
options: Only the zero-length raw value is empty, so whitespace-only values start successfully.
Normalization runs first, so a whitespace-only value is empty and stops start-up.
open_points.default_guess: Treat only the zero-length raw value as empty, because every non-empty form is expressly accepted at start.

witness.initial: Every required environment variable is valid, and REGISTRY_BASE_URL is three space characters.
events: The deployment operator starts the service.
outcomes: Start-up succeeds because the raw value is non-empty; a later Registry call fails as transport_error.
Start-up stops because normalization turns the value into an empty string.

open_points.subject: A30 and A6 — Registry base-URL acceptance and path joining
open_points.text: The start-up check refuses only a missing or empty value; which values the gateway accepts as a base URL and how it joins them with the request paths stay the accepted gateway's (note `_registry_url`, the Registry path constants), carried to States 6–7.
open_points.question: What exact URL forms does the gateway refuse, and what exact normalization and joining algorithm applies to paths, trailing slashes, queries, fragments, ports and percent-encoding?
options: Specify the complete accepted URL grammar and deterministic joining rules in State 2.
Declare every non-empty http/https URL without user information acceptable and define a standard URL-resolution operation.
Define a narrower base-URL grammar, including explicit refusal of query, fragment or other disallowed components.
open_points.default_guess: Accept only absolute http/https URLs without user information, query or fragment, normalize one trailing slash, and append each path segment with URL-aware joining.

witness.initial: REGISTRY_BASE_URL is https://registry.example/root?tenant=a and all other start-up settings are valid.
events: The deployment operator starts the service.
An API caller triggers a Registry validation call.
outcomes: The gateway accepts the value as an HTTPS base and joins the validation path to it.
The gateway treats a query-bearing URL as not being a base URL and returns transport_error before making a request.

open_points.subject: A30 and 02_rules.md:Classification principles — binary storage environment values
open_points.text: a value that depends on the deployment (URLs, origins, hosts, size bounds, rate limits) — a row of the start-up table `config.runtime_environment_variables`, validated once at start by `runtime_settings` and read into a field of `RuntimeSettings`; the one exception is the two binary storage rows (`BINARY_STORAGE_ROOT`, `BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES`), which have no field and which the emitted `binary_storage` reads at each read, as the Factory's binary storage backend is built (A14, A30).
open_points.question: Are BINARY_STORAGE_ROOT and BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES immutable start-up settings loaded once into RuntimeSettings, or environment variables reread by binary_storage for every operation?
options: Load both once into RuntimeSettings fields and pass those values to binary_storage.
Validate them at start but reread the process environment on every binary read.
Load an immutable binary-storage configuration object once, distinct from RuntimeSettings.
open_points.default_guess: Load both once into typed settings fields and pass the immutable values to binary_storage.

witness.initial: BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES is 100 when the service starts, and a stored binary has 75 bytes.
events: The deployment operator starts the service successfully.
The process environment is changed so BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES is 50 without restarting the service.
An authorized client requests the 75-byte binary.
outcomes: The read succeeds because configuration was read once at start and remains 100.
The read is refused because binary_storage rereads the environment and observes 50.

open_points.subject: 02_rules.md:Classification principles
open_points.text:
the one exception is the two binary storage rows
  (`BINARY_STORAGE_ROOT`, `BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES`), which have no field and
  which the emitted `binary_storage` reads at each read, as the Factory's
  binary storage backend is built (A14, A30).
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Replace the exception with settings-object fields, or reclassify the values into another path that 15.3.1 permits.

open_points.subject: A30: Accepted decision A30 — Configuration — binary_read_limit_env_name
open_points.text:
`binary_read_limit_env_name`: the binary read limit is the environment
  variable `BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES`, a required row of the start-up table that
  `load_runtime_settings` validates at start without a `RuntimeSettings`
  field; the emitted `binary_storage` reads it at each read through its
  backend IR (Factory `a6916180314d`). No model-written module reads it.
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Make BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES a field of the settings object used by generated code, or place it on another permitted 15.3.1 path.

open_points.subject: A30: Accepted decision A30 — Configuration — Consequence
open_points.text: A deployment value is a row of `config.runtime_environment_variables` read only by `load_runtime_settings`, into a field of `RuntimeSettings` (`database_url`, `environment`, `public_origin`, `trusted_hosts`, `allowed_origins`, `max_request_body_bytes`, `max_binary_response_bytes`, `production_logging`, the two viewer-entry limits and, since 2026-11-09, `registry_base_url`), except the two binary storage rows, which the emitted `binary_storage` reads.
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Remove the exception and state the settings-object fields through which both binary storage deployment values reach binary_storage.
